title: Parameterized Quantum Circuit Semantics Through Enriched Categories
summary: It is well-known that combinatorial circuits are modeled mathematically by string diagrams in monoidal categories. Given a gate set $Σ$, the circuits over $Σ$ can be thought of as string diagrams in the free monoidal category generated by $Σ$. In this model, circuit semantics are then given by monoidal functors out of this free category. For quantum circuits, this functor is often valued in the category of unitary matrices.
